name: codex-plugin-claude-agent-team
description: Single-plugin marketplace for codex-plugin-claude-agent-team. Adding this marketplace exposes one Claude Code plugin: the agent-team MCP runtime with provider-routed multi-agent execution.

plugins.name: codex-plugin-claude-agent-team
plugins.description: Provider-neutral agent team MCP plugin. Durable multi-agent workflows over a slice DAG with inter-agent mailboxes (inbox/outbox/control/events), isolated write worktrees, slice-review-before-integration, and provider routing across Claude Code CLI, codex-cli, gemini, grok, openai-compatible, ollama-cloud, and ollama-claude-code. Complements codex-paired-superpowers (which owns spec/plan + audit gate) by owning execution.
